study type: Secondary analysis of a cohort study
cohort: 788 full-term, breastfed and stable babies born in 2007-2012 consecutively enrolled to primary care pediatric clinics in Majorca, Spain
finding: While in-hospital weight loss above the median predicted exclusive breastfeeding cessation by 15, 30, and 100 days of life, extreme birthweight loss did not trigger immediate formula supplementation.
